title: Fuel Desk Terms: The Refined Fuels Rate a Member's Gallon Position Earns on a Restated Membership and Patronage Equity Notice
content:
Where the member's own fuel programme standing earns a rate on the refined fuels basis, that programme rate stands in place of the rate the notice carries for it. The same reasoning that governs prepaid crop input money governs gallons: gallons bought forward are the cooperative's working capital through the season. The position is read from the member's Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts.

**Where a contracted position stands.** Where a refined fuels account stands on the Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account programme with contracted gallons still owed on it and a refined fuels account stands active, the refined fuels rate is 0.03 in the gallon, that is three cents in the gallon.

**Where an account stands open with no contracted gallons.** Where a refined fuels account stands active and no contracted gallons stand owed on the contract gallon pre-buy programme, the refined fuels rate is 0.021 in the gallon, that is two and one tenth cents in the gallon.

**Where no account stands active.** Where no refined fuels account stands active at all, the rate the notice carries for the refined fuels basis stands.

## Boundary cases on hypothetical records

| Contracted gallons still owed on the contract gallon pre-buy programme | A refined fuels account standing active | Refined fuels rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2400 | yes | 0.03 |
| none | yes | 0.021 |
| 2400 | no | the rate the notice carries |
| none | no | the rate the notice carries |

Gallons owed of none is the boundary between the first two lines: the first asks for contracted gallons still owed, and where none are owed the second line governs so long as an account stands active.

**Worked on hypothetical figures.** A refined fuels volume of 5000.00 gallons standing accrued for the year earns 150.00 at 0.03 in the gallon and 105.00 at 0.021 in the gallon. Membership and Patronage Equity carries the difference straight into the restated allocation.
